summary: CarMax Auto Funding LLC, as depositor and seller, filed a 424B5 prospectus for CarMax Auto Owner Trust 2026-4, a $1.333 billion auto-loan ABS offering (eleven tranches, approximately $1.35 billion stated). Terms include Class A-1 at 4.378% due October 2027, Class A-2a at 5.01% due February 2030, floating A-2b at SOFR plus 0.50%, and A-3 at 5.38% due January 2032, with subordinated B/C/D classes yielding up to 6.32%. Credit enhancement is subordination, overcollateralization, a reserve account and excess collections; the sponsor retains roughly 1.25% of each class for risk retention. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
